title: O3-MINI VS DEEPSEEK-R1: WHICH ONE IS SAFER?

bias_targets.methodology: Automated generation of unsafe test inputs (prompts) using the ASTRAL tool targeted at the safety category 'Discrimination, stereotype, injustice' (C4), combined with various writing styles and persuasion techniques, and evaluated using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-3.5) to determine if the model output is safe or unsafe.
